content:
The highly anticipated Emmy Awards kick off this weekend, with the Creative Arts categories announcing winners first. The primetime ceremony will be held on September 14, when top honours including Best Drama Series and Best Comedy Series will be presented.

For now, Apple certainly has reason to celebrate — Apple TV+ stormed into the weekend with a record-breaking 20 awards. The vast majority came from the comedy *Widows Bay*, which swept 8 awards and has emerged as the frontrunner for Best Comedy Series.

So far, Apple leads the 2026 Emmys with 20 awards, followed by HBO Max with 16 and Netflix with 13. Once the primetime Emmys are fully handed out, the latter two are expected to overtake Apple in total wins, though Apple should still secure a respectable third place.

Apple is expected to shine in the comedy categories but may be outshone in drama by contenders like *The Pitt*. The answers will be revealed next Monday.

According to current tallies: *Widows Bay* took 8 awards, *Pluribus* 4, *Margo's Got Money Troubles* 3, *Palm Royale* 3, and the documentary *Mr Scorsese* 1.

Apple TV+ originals account for 19 of those; add Apple's advertisement *I'm Not Remarkable* with its 1 win, and the total comes to exactly 20:

*Widow's Bay*

  • Outstanding Guest Actress in a Comedy Series: Betty Gilpin
  • Outstanding Art Direction for a Half-Hour Narrative Program
  • Outstanding Casting for a Comedy Series
  • Outstanding Cinematography for a Series (Half-Hour)
  • Outstanding Original Music for a Series (Original Dramatic Score)
  • Outstanding Music Supervision
  • Outstanding Sound Editing for a Comedy or Drama Series (Half-Hour) or Animation
  • Outstanding Sound Mixing for a Comedy or Drama Series (Half-Hour) or Animation

*Pluribus*

  • Outstanding Art Direction for a Contemporary Narrative Program (One Hour or More per Episode)
  • Outstanding Editing for a Drama Series
  • Outstanding Original Main Title Theme Music
  • Outstanding Sound Mixing for a Comedy or Drama Series (One Hour per Episode)

*Margo's Got Money Troubles*

  • Outstanding Contemporary Costumes for a Series
  • Outstanding Contemporary Hairstyling
  • Outstanding Contemporary Makeup (Non-Prosthetic)

*Palm Royale*

  • Outstanding Choreography for Scripted Programming
  • Outstanding Period or Fantasy/Sci-Fi Costumes
  • Outstanding Period or Fantasy/Sci-Fi Makeup (Non-Prosthetic)

*Mr. Scorsese*

  • Outstanding Documentary or Nonfiction Series

Apple TV+ entered the season with a record-breaking 89 Emmy nominations; when the primetime ceremony takes place on September 14, we will see how many of those convert into wins. These figures once again reflect industry critics' strong recognition of the overall quality of Apple's programming.
